blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: LLM-based peer review is now used at production scale, but its evaluation remains limited. We introduce a benchmark that injects objective, localisable errors of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at three severity levels into real papers and measures each reviewer's detection rate by error type and severity, together with its false-positive rate on clean copies. We also present Skepthical, a multi-agent reviewer that verifies citation-backed claims by retrieving the cited papers, mathematics with computer algebra, and numerical claims with executed code. We apply the benchmark to two corpora of 15 recent arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in machine learning (ML), injecting a total of 357 errors, and evaluate twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available reviewers, and Skepthical. The choice of model has the largest impact on detection rate: given the same prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 percentage points in total detection on both corpora. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforced citation retrieval gives Skepthical the highest citation error detection rate of all systems by a large margin. This citation lead, however, is not observed on ML, where the models appear to know the literature better and Skepthical's citation detection rate is statistically indistinguishable from that of the best single LLM. False-positive rates are below 10% for most systems, but vary with prompt, model, and scaffolding, with mathematics flags the main source of false positives. The evaluation pipeline, the injected errors, and the adjudication logs are released as a benchmark.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Peer review is a cornerstone of the scientific process. With AI tools becoming increasingly used in research and AI scientists starting to conduct research at scale [ 3 , 13 , 26 , 18 , 19 , 25 , 22 , 7 ] , the need for reliable and scalable peer review is greater than ever. In parallel, LLM-based peer review has reached production scale in 2026, with a growing ecosystem of AI reviewers and review venues [ 16 , 1 , 8 , 20 , 2 , 5 , 4 , 28 ] . Despite the publication of the first AI-reviewer benchmarks [ 10 ] , methodology for evaluating these AI reviewers has generally lagged behind. Evaluation is most often framed either as alignment with human-written reviews [ 11 , 5 , 16 ] or as synthetic error injection on Machine Learning (ML) papers only [ 20 , 2 , 24 , 6 ] , with important issues such as false-positive rates or error detection as a function of the error severity not being typically investigated.
blocks.zh: 同行审查是科学进程的基石。 随着AI工具在研究中越来越多地被使用,AI科学家开始进行规模研究[3,13,26,18,19,25,22,7],对可靠和可扩展的同行评审的需求比以往任何时候都大. 与此同时,基于LLM的同级审评在2026年已经达到了生产规模,AI审评员的生态系统和审评场所[16, 1, 8, 20, 2, 5, 4, 28]不断增长. 尽管发布了首个AI-审查者基准[10],但评估这些AI审查者的方法总体上落后了. 评价往往被描述为与人文评论[11,5,16]相配合,或者仅仅在机器学习(ML)论文上合成错误注入[20,2,24,6],诸如假阳性率或错误检测等重要问题与一般不调查的错误严重程度有关.

blocks.en:
This paper addresses these concerns with two primary contributions. First, we introduce
an evaluation pipeline for reviewer systems that injects errors into a paper’s L a T e X source at three severity levels (subtle, clear, blatant) across four error types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations), and then measures i) the error detection rate for each severity level and error type and ii) the false-positive rates (on a copy with no injected errors). The verdicts are adjudicated by a cross-family LLM panel (Anthropic + OpenAI + Google) following recent LLM-as-judge prescriptions [ 15 , 21 , 27 ] , with additional mechanical verifiers for mathematics and numerics. Our ‘dose-response’ design extends perturbation-based behavioural evaluation [ 17 , 29 ] with graded severity levels inspired by [ 14 ] . We note that our benchmark focuses on whether reviewers can detect objective, localisable issues (e.g., numerical and mathematical errors, misrepresented citations, internal inconsistencies), leaving aside questions such as significance and novelty assessment or overall review quality, which are harder to quantify.
blocks.zh:
本文以两项主要贡献解决了这些问题。 首先,我们介绍
用于审查者系统的评价管道,在四种错误类型(一般问题、数学、数字、引文)的3个重度(低度、清晰、明目张胆地)向纸张的L a T e X源注入出错,然后衡量每类重度和出错类型的出错率和出错率。 判决由跨家族的LLM小组(Anthropic + OpenAI + Google)根据近期LLM-as-judge的处方[15,21,27]作出裁定,并增加数学和数值的机械验证器. 我们的`剂量反应 ' 设计扩展了以扰动为基础的行为评价[17、29],其严重程度等级受[14]的启发。 我们注意到,我们的基准侧重于审查者是否能够发现客观、可识别的问题(例如,数字和数学错误、错误引用、内部不一致),而忽略了意义和新颖性评估或总体审查质量等问题,这些问题难以量化。

blocks.en: Second, we introduce Skepthical , an LLM-powered paper reviewer comprising four specialist modules: a citations module that retrieves and reads the cited papers, a mathematics module that verifies mathematical claims using computer algebra, a numerics module that verifies numerical results through executed code, and a general-issues module consisting of an ensemble of cross-family LLMs. Unlike prior reviewers that rely entirely on LLMs, Skepthical verifies LLM-flagged issues where possible: the mathematics and numerics modules use computer algebra and executed code, respectively, while the citations module checks the claims directly against the retrieved PDFs of cited papers.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们引入了Skepthical,一个LLM动力的纸质审查器,由四个专家模块组成:一个检索并阅读所引用论文的引用模块,一个使用计算机代数验证数学主张的数学模块,一个通过执行代码验证数值结果的数值模块,以及一个由跨家庭LLMs组成的组合. 与完全依靠LLMs的前审查者不同的是,Skepthical在可能情况下验证了LLM-flaged问题:数学和数字模块分别使用计算机代数和已执行代码,而引用模块则直接对照所引用论文被检索到的PDF对索赔进行核对.

blocks.en: We apply our evaluation pipeline to two corpora of 15 recent astrophysics arXiv preprints and 15 ML preprints, benchmarking Skepthical alongside eleven additional reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, and three publicly available external AI reviewers (the Stanford Agentic Reviewer [ 16 ] , OpenReviewer-8B [ 8 ] , and the PaperAudit-Bench detector [ 20 ] ). To our knowledge, our application to the astrophysics corpus is the first controlled comparison of AI peer-reviewer systems on a real, non-ML scientific paper corpus. We release the evaluation pipeline, together with the paper lists, injection catalogues, and full adjudication logs, as a public benchmark at github.com/inigozubeldia/skepthical-benchmark .
blocks.zh: 我们把评价程序应用于最近15个天体物理学arXiv预印和15个ML预印的2个公司,将Skephical和另外11个审查员系统作为基准:6个单一LLM审查员,2个克洛德代码配置,以及3个可公开使用的外部AI审查员(斯坦福代理审查员[16],OpenReviewer-8B [8],以及PaperAudit-Bench探测器[20])。 据我们所知,我们对天体物理学体的应用是AI同行评审系统在真实的非ML科学论文体上的首次受控比较. 我们公布评估管道,连同纸面清单、注入目录和完整的裁定日志,作为在github.com/inigozubeldia/skepthical-benchmark的公共基准。

blocks.en: Table 1 positions this work against prior AI peer-review systems and benchmarks across nine evaluation axes. No prior work grades severity levels or uses a cross-family adjudication panel; only one [ 11 ] covers papers beyond ML/NLP; only one [ 6 ] provides false-positive control; and only one [ 2 ] integrates mechanical verifiers. This work is the first to combine all five. Unlike in some previous work, our review adjudication is LLM-based (with additional mechanical checks for mathematics and numerics), although we check the performance of our pipeline against a human annotator on one paper.

blocks.en: 2 Benchmark design
blocks.zh: 2 基准设计

blocks.en: 2.1 Reviewer systems
blocks.zh: 2.1 审查员制度

blocks.en: We evaluate the following twelve reviewer systems.
blocks.zh: 我们评价以下十二个审查员制度。

blocks.en:
• Skepthical (full pipeline description in Appendix A ). Skepthical is a multi-agent reviewer with four parallel specialist modules: (i) general issues , which uses two cross-family LLMs (Claude Opus 4.7 and Gemini 2.5 Pro) to generate two independent reports that are then merged by a third-family model (GPT-5.1), alongside a free-form reading of the paper by a reasoning model (GPT-5.4); (ii) mathematics , in which the paper’s key mathematical statements are extracted and internally-verifiable claims are verified mechanically with either wolframscript or pint (the former for symbolic equality, the latter for dimensional analysis); (iii) numerics , in which the consistency of the numerical statements in the paper is verified with Python code; and (iv) citations , in which every key factual statement relying on external references is verified with an LLM with the cited papers provided in its context. To our knowledge, Skepthical is the first AI peer reviewer that combines mechanical verification of mathematics and numerics with retrieval-based verification of factual citations. It is publicly accessible at skepthical-ai.org . The configuration evaluated below is the public release frozen on 2026-04-21, one day before the 2026-04-22 arXiv submissions from which the astrophysics corpus is sampled (§ 2.2 ). No prompt or model choice was tuned in response to the papers or results reported in this paper. • Single-LLM reviewers. We consider two configurations of a single-LLM reviewer: a free-form configuration, run with a one-sentence prompt (‘ Write a referee report for this scientific paper as if you were a journal referee ’), and a structured configuration, run with the full operating instructions of all of Skepthical ’s agents compiled into one 978-line prompt (report-merging and tool-output adjudication agents removed and with analogous mechanical-verification-free instructions given for mathematics and numerics). Both configurations are evaluated for three different models (Claude Opus 4.7, GPT-5.5, and Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, hereafter Gemini 3.1 Pro), giving six single-LLM reviewers in total. We further evaluate a concise version of the structured configuration in Appendix H . • Claude Code. We use the frontier general-purpose coding agent Claude Code [ 46 ] , running with Claude Opus 4.7 in a sandbox with the following allowed tools: Read , Bash , Grep , Glob , python3 (with NumPy, SymPy, SciPy, pint ), wolframscript , and arXiv access. As for the single-LLM reviewers, we consider two configurations (sharing model, sandbox, and tools): a free-form configuration, run with the same one-sentence referee prompt as in the free-form single-LLM reviewers, and a structured configuration, run with a prompt containing Skepthical ’s full operating instructions. • Three publicly available external reviewers. (i) The Stanford Agentic Reviewer at paperreview.ai [ 16 ] (closed-source, internals undocumented, queried on 2026-05-01; only run on the astrophysics corpus); (ii) OpenReviewer-8B [ 8 ] , an open-weights Llama-3.1-8B fine-tuned on ≈ 79 \approx 79\, K ICLR / NeurIPS reviews, self-hosted and invoked with the published ICLR-template prompt; and (iii) the PaperAudit-Bench detector [ 20 ] , an open-weights Qwen3-14B-based reviewer, run in
Deep mode. We do not retrain or re-prompt any of these
reviewers.

深会模式。 我们不重新训练 或重新推动任何这些
审者.

blocks.en: Together, the twelve systems allow for three comparisons and one external reference point. The first comparison is the effect of the prompt , as within the single-LLM group and within the Claude Code group, the free-form and structured configurations differ only in the prompt. The second is the effect of the agentic loop with tool-use : at each prompt level, the Claude Code configuration can be compared with the Claude Opus 4.7 single-LLM configuration with the same prompt, so the difference between them is not the instructions but the ability to perform several LLM calls, run code, read files, and fetch cited papers. The third is the effect of agentic scaffolding : structured Claude Code and Skepthical share the same operating instructions, but in Skepthical those instructions are executed by dedicated specialist agents that are enforced to run, whereas Claude Code has a much less strict scaffolding. Finally, the three external reviewers show how publicly available systems that an author could use today perform on the same benchmark, and the two open-weights reviewers also test whether small models fine-tuned on review data can compete with frontier systems. Two caveats apply: i) Skepthical uses models from all three providers, so its margin over any single-provider system mixes the effect of the pipeline with that of cross-provider ensembling, and ii) none of these comparisons is a capacity-matched ablation of Skepthical . Compute resources and asset licences are summarised in Appendix M .
blocks.zh: 12个系统加在一起可以进行3个比较和一个外部参考点。 第一次比较是快动的效果. 因为单-LLM组内和克洛德码组内,自由形式和结构化的配置只在快动中有所不同. 二是代理循环与工具使用的效果 : 在每一个即时关卡, Claude 代码配置可以与 Claude Opus 4.7 单-LLM 配置进行对比,并使用相同的即时关卡,所以它们之间的区别不是指令,而是能够执行几个LLM调用,运行代码,阅读文件,并获取被引用的论文. 第三是代理脚手架的效果:结构化的克洛德代码和斯克普蒂克共享相同的操作指令,但在斯克普蒂克语中,这些指令由被强制运行的专职专家特工执行,而克洛德代码的脚手架则要严格得多. 最后,三位外部评审员展示了作者今天可以使用的公开系统如何在同一个基准上表现,两位开放量级评审员还测试了在评审数据上微调的小模型是否能够与前沿系统相竞争. 两种说明适用:(一) Skepthical使用来自所有三个供应商的模型,因此它相对于任何单一供应商系统的比值将管道的效果与交叉供应商综艺的效果相混合;和(二) 这些比较都不是Skepthical的能力相匹配的差值。 附录M概述了计算资源和资产许可证的情况。

blocks.en: We evaluate on two corpora of 15 arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in ML. Each corpus consists of submissions to a single arXiv category on a single recent day, capped at 20 pages to limit cost. The astrophysics corpus comprises 15 of the 24 astro-ph submissions of 2026-04-22 within the page cap (median 13 pages), whereas the ML corpus comprises 15 of the 74 eligible cs.LG submissions of 2026-07-15, drawn by stratified random sampling over eight subfields (median 9 pages, range 3–19). Both chosen days postdate the knowledge cut-off of every model we use. Both paper lists are given in Appendix B .

blocks.en: Astrophysics was chosen for its abundant formal mathematics and numerics, two key aspects that our benchmark evaluates, and because most existing AI-reviewer evaluations have run on ML papers [ 20 , 2 , 11 , 8 , 5 ] . ML was added as the second corpus i) to test whether our conclusions hold beyond a single field and ii) because it is the field on which the two fine-tuned open-weights external reviewers were trained, so their performance can be measured in-distribution as well as out of it. We note that no component or prompt in any of the reviewer systems is field-specific.
blocks.zh: 天体物理学因其丰富的正规数学和数字学而入选,这是我们基准评价的两个关键方面,而且因为大多数现有的AI-审查者评价是在ML论文上进行的[20,2,11,8,5]. ML被添加为第二要素一),以检验我们的结论是否超越一个领域和(二),因为两个微调的开放量外部审查员是在这一领域接受培训的,因此其业绩既可以分配,也可以从中衡量。 我们注意到,在任何审查员制度中,没有任何组成部分或即时内容是针对外地的。

blocks.en: 2.3 Error injection
blocks.zh: 2.3 错误注入

blocks.en: For each paper, four versions are reviewed: one clean copy (used to assess false positives) and three error-injected copies, each carrying one error of each of four types (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations) at a chosen severity ( S 1 S_{1} subtle, S 2 S_{2} clear, or S 3 S_{3} blatant). Across the three injected copies of a paper, every (error type, severity) combination appears exactly once (see Appendix C.1 ). Spreading the 12 injections across three copies (rather than concentrating them in one) keeps the per-copy error density small, which we take to be more representative of a typical real paper. Each corpus thus leads to 15 clean and 45 error-injected copies, with the astrophysics corpus containing a total of 15 × 12 − 3 = 177 15\times 12-3=177 injected errors (one paper had too few equations to admit mathematics injections) and its ML counterpart, 180 180 .
blocks.zh: 对每份文件审查四个版本:一个干净的复制件(用于评估虚假的正文)和三个错误输入的复制件,每份都带有四种类型(一般问题、数学、数字、引文)中的一个错误,其严重程度是选定的(S 1 S_{1}微妙,S 2 S_{2}清楚,或S 3 S_{3}公然)。 在所注入的一纸三份副本中,每一份(错误类型、严重程度)的组合都只出现一次(见附录C.1)。 将这12个注射分出3个拷贝(而不是集中在1个拷贝中),使每份拷贝的错误密度保持了小,我们认为这更能代表典型的真纸. 因此,每个体都得到15个干净和45个误入的拷贝,天体物理体共包含15×12 − 3 =177 15\times 12-3=177个注入出错(一份文件的方程式太少,无法接受数学注入)及其ML对应的180 180个。

blocks.en: Representative examples of the three severity levels, by error type, are as follows (full taxonomy with examples in Appendix C ). Citations run from a 1 σ \sigma value shift misquotation ( S 1 S_{1} ) through a significant methodology misattribution ( S 2 S_{2} ) to a reversed cited conclusion ( S 3 S_{3} ); numerics from an abstract–body second-decimal drift ( S 1 S_{1} ) through a digit swap or percent-of error ( S 2 S_{2} ) to a structural inconsistency such as percentages summing above 100 % ( S 3 S_{3} ); mathematics from a sign flip on a subleading term ( S 1 S_{1} ) through an operator swap or normalisation drop ( S 2 S_{2} ) to a dimensional absurdity ( S 3 S_{3} ); and general issues from a typo ( S 1 S_{1} ) through a methods–results inconsistency or phantom-evidence insertion ( S 2 S_{2} ) to an abstract–body contradiction ( S 3 S_{3} ). We note that the taxonomy may not fully reflect the distribution of naturally occurring errors in papers and that severity levels are designed to be calibrated within each error type but not across them, so a given severity label may not represent the same detection difficulty across error types.

blocks.en: Detection matching. For each (paper, injected copy, reviewer), the review plus the error-injection records are given to a three-judge cross-family panel (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.4, and Gemini 3 Flash Preview, hereafter Gemini 3 Flash). Each judge returns a verdict for each injection ( { \{ detected, confidence, matching_evidence, reason } \} ); the final verdict is the 3-way majority. Low-confidence or 2-1 ambiguous verdicts trigger a PDF-attached escalation pass, in which a single judge (Claude Sonnet 4.6) adjudicates the injection with the full paper PDF in context.
blocks.zh: 检测匹配。 对于每张(纸,注射副本,审查员),评审结果加上误入记录交给由三名法官组成的跨家庭小组(Claude Sonnet 4.6,GPT-5.4和双子座3闪光预览,以下简称双子座3闪光). 每个裁判员对每次注射({\{被检测出,自信,匹配_证据,理由}}{;最终裁判为3向多数. 低信心或2-1的模棱两可的判决触发了PDF所附带的升级通行证,其中一名法官(克洛德·索内特(Claude Sonnet 4.6))在上下文中用完整的纸上PDF来裁定注射.

blocks.en:
Across the 4,084 4{,}084 per-error-type adjudications in the two corpora ( 2,104 2{,}104 astrophysics, 1,980 1{,}980 ML), 93.5% reach unanimous first-round agreement (3-0) and 6.5% are 2-1 splits.
The PDF-attached escalation fires on 34.9% of injections (38.7% astrophysics, 30.8% ML), with the dominant trigger being panel uncertainty rather than disagreement. Of the escalated injections, 92.3% confirm the first-round majority, and 73.6% return at high confidence. Aggregating across both stages, 97.3% of all adjudications end with a verdict that was either accepted at first round or confirmed under PDF re-judgement, only 2.7% are reversed by the escalation pass, and 91.6% reach unanimous agreement across every judge that voted (first-round panel plus, where applicable, the escalation pass). Only 7.4% of adjudications retain a low-confidence verdict after escalation. The adjudication is therefore highly self-consistent (judge-level agreement statistics in Appendix D ).

blocks.en: The detection results understate the contribution of the mechanical verifiers. A frontier LLM matching Skepthical ’s 80 % 80\,\% numerics detection rate is not the same finding as Skepthical delivering 80 % 80\,\% recall through tool-mediated deterministic computation. Skepthical ’s checks invoke deterministic tools (Python calculations, wolframscript , pint , and arXiv-PDF retrieval) on every checked claim and are auditable in source, while the single-LLM equivalent is a single forward pass whose correctness on any given equation is opaque and non-reproducible. Claude Code with the structured prompt sits between the two: it has the same tool affordances as Skepthical , but only invokes them on a fraction of instances (and never wolframscript , despite the prompt’s encouragement), so its detections are mechanically grounded only on the instances where the agent chose to run a verification script.

Claude Code 与结构化的快报坐于两者之间:它与Skepthical 具有相同的工具承受能力,但只引用其中的一小部分(尽管快报的鼓励,却从未引用过狼语),因此它的探测只能机械地基于特工选择运行验证脚本的情况.

blocks.en: 4 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4 限制

blocks.en: The benchmark measures one part of peer review: whether a reviewer detects objective, localisable defects (citation support, mathematical and numerical correctness, internal consistency) and whether it raises false alarms on clean papers. The benchmark does not address issues such as novelty, significance, adequacy of experiments, missing controls, interpretive judgement, or alignment with human-written reviews, as they are significantly harder to quantify and, in general, lack a clear ground truth. Therefore, our results should not be interpreted as holistic measurements of review quality.
blocks.zh: 该基准衡量同行审评的一部份:审查者是否发现客观的,可定位的缺陷(引用支持,数学和数字正确性,内部一致性),以及是否在干净的纸张上引起虚假的警报. 基准不处理诸如新颖性、意义、实验的充分性、缺少控制、解释性判断或与人文评论相一致等问题,因为这些问题在量化上明显困难,而且一般来说缺乏明确的依据。 因此,我们的结果不应被解释为对审查质量的全面衡量。

blocks.en:
Each corpus is small: 15 papers from one day in one field, capped at 20 pages. The rates reported here are therefore estimates for
those two slices, and longer manuscripts are not represented. As already noted, severity labels are calibrated within each error type but not across them. In addition, each injected copy carries four errors, and a blatant one might draw attention away from a subtle one in the same copy. Because severities were assigned independently for each error type, the severity of the other errors in a copy varies at random. We find that whether an error is detected does not depend measurably on how severe its neighbours are (Appendix K ). However, this test cannot ascertain whether the mere presence of other errors has an effect; that would require copies carrying a single error, which was beyond the cost constraints of this work.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper we have introduced an evaluation pipeline for AI peer reviewers that injects errors of four types and three severity levels into real papers and measures the detection rate as a function of error type, severity, prompt, and reviewer architecture, together with the false-positive rate on clean copies. We have applied it to two corpora of 15 real arXiv preprints each, one in astrophysics and one in ML, and benchmarked twelve reviewer systems: six single-LLM reviewers, two Claude Code configurations, three publicly available external reviewers, and Skepthical . Skepthical is a multi-agent reviewer, also introduced here, with a reference-attached citation verifier, a computer-algebra-backed mathematics auditor, a code-backed numerical auditor, and a cross-family general-issues ensemble. The evaluation pipeline, together with the injection catalogues, and the full adjudication logs, is released as a benchmark for the AI-reviewer landscape at github.com/inigozubeldia/skepthical-benchmark , and Skepthical is publicly available at skepthical-ai.org .
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们为AI同行审评员引入了一个评价管道,将四种类型和三种严重程度的错误注入到真实的论文中,并测量检测率作为错误类型、严重性、即时和评审员架构的函数,以及干净副本上的虚假阳性率。 我们把它应用到每个15个真实arXiv预印的2个公司,一个在天体物理学,一个在ML, 以及基准化的12个审查员系统:6个单LLM审查员,2个克洛德代码配置,3个公开的外部审查员,以及Skepthical。 Skephthical是一个多代理审查员,也在这里介绍,有参考文献后附的引用验证员,计算机代数后附的数学审计员,密码后附的数字审计员,以及跨家族的通用问题综艺. 在github.com/inigozubeldia/skepthical-benchmark上发布评估管道以及注入目录和完整的裁定日志,作为AI-审查者景观的基准,Skepthical在skepthical-ai.org上公开发布。

blocks.en: Our main conclusions are as follows. 1. The choices of model and prompt make a difference. Given the same one-sentence prompt, three frontier LLMs differ by about 50 ​ pp 50\,\mathrm{pp} in total detection on both corpora, mostly on mathematics and numerics. The longer structured prompt narrows this spread by lifting the weaker models. For Claude Code, with model and tools fixed, the same prompt change alone triggers extensive tool use and raises detection by over 30 ​ pp 30\,\mathrm{pp} on both corpora. 2. Tools and scaffolding help when they contribute what the model cannot supply on its own. In particular, on astrophysics, Claude Code improves significantly on a single Claude call in mathematics and numerics detection, and enforcing citation retrieval gives Skepthical a large citation lead there. On ML, however, where the models appear to know the literature better, enforced retrieval does not lead to a significant improvement. 3. Detection rises with severity for every capable system, whereas the two fine-tuned open-weights reviewers have a negligible detection rate. 4. False-positive rates are generally low, below 10 % 10\,\% for most systems apart from the open-weights reviewers, but depend on prompt, model, and scaffolding. Mathematics flags are the least reliable and account for half of all false positives; Skepthical keeps a low rate on both corpora.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要结论如下。 1. 模式和迅速的选择会有所改变。 由于同样的一刑一发,三种边疆LLMs在总检测中在双子体上相差约50pp 50\,\mathrm{pp},多为数学和数子. 通过抬起更弱的模型,结构化的更长的即时缩小了这种扩散. 对于Claude Code,在模型和工具被固定后,同样的即时变化单独触发了广泛的工具使用,并提升了30多页30\,\mathrm{pp}在两个corpora上的检测. 2. 工具和脚手架的帮助,当它们贡献了模型自己无法提供的东西时。 特别是在天体物理学方面,克洛德代码在数学和数字检测方面对克洛德单调有很大的改进,强制引用检索使斯克普蒂克特尔在那里获得了一个大型的被引用的领先. 但是,关于ML,如果模型似乎更了解文献,强制检索不会导致重大改进。 3. 对每个有能力的系统,检测都随着严重程度而增加,而两个经过微调的开放重量审查员的检测率微不足道。 4. 假阳性率一般较低,除开放重量审查员外,大多数系统低于10%-10%-%,但取决于迅速、模型和脚手架。 数学旗最不可靠,占所有假阳性者的一半; Skepthical在两只蝎子上保持了低速率.

blocks.en: Appendix A Skepthical pipeline detail
blocks.zh: 附录A 滑动管道细节

blocks.en: Skepthical reviews a paper with a pipeline of specialised agents rather than with a single LLM call. The paper is processed in parallel by four modules, one each for general issues, mathematics, numerics, and citations, and their outputs are merged at the end into a single structured review (Figure 3 ). Table 3 lists the model used by every agent in the configuration run in this work.
blocks.zh: Skeepthical审查一份文件,其中包含一批专门人员,而不是一个LLM呼叫。 文件由四个单元平行处理,一般问题、数学、数字和引文各一个单元,其产出最后合并为单一结构审查(图3)。 表3列出了本作运行的配置中每个代理所使用的模型.

blocks.en: Figure 3: The Skepthical pipeline. The paper PDF is processed in parallel by four specialist modules (general issues, mathematics, numerics, citations); each module is a short chain of LLM agents (robot icons) interleaved with mechanical or deterministic engines (gear icons). Module outputs converge in a final assembly step that produces the markdown review: main issues from the three audits are added to the structured general-issues report, the result is merged with the unstructured report by unstructured_report_merger , and the three audits are also appended in full.
blocks.zh: 图3:滑石管. 纸上PDF由四个专家模块(一般问题,数学,数字,引文)同步处理;每个模块是LLM代理(robot图标)与机械或定型引擎(gear图标)相接的短链. 模块产出汇合在产生减记审查的最后集合步骤中:三个审计的主要问题被添加到结构化的一般问题报告中,结果与结构化的无结构报告被合并,三个审计也被全部附上.

blocks.en: A.1 General-issues module
blocks.zh: A.1 一般问题单元

blocks.en: The general-issues module produces the backbone of the review. It has two parts: a structured stage, in which two LLMs from different families are combined so that the issues raised do not depend on a single family, and a parallel free-form reading of the paper by a single reasoning model.
blocks.zh: 一般问题单元产生审查的主干。 它有两个部分:一个结构化的阶段,将来自不同家庭的两个LLMs合并在一起,这样所提出的问题就不会依赖于一个家庭;另一个阶段是用一个单一的推理模型平行地自由阅读论文.

blocks.en: The first stage is the total_reviewer ensemble: two parallel calls, one on Claude Opus 4.7 and one on Gemini 2.5 Pro, each returning a summary, a list of strengths, and three lists of issues by severity ( major , minor , and very minor ) in a fixed JSON format. Both calls use the same operating instructions, which require a coverage checklist of five categories (general, logical consistency, evidence and citations, presentation and clarity, reproducibility), a consistency pass across sections on named choices and re-used quantities, an audit of rhetoric and scope intended to catch sweeping generalisations and contradictions in direction or kind, and a phantom-evidence audit in which every reference to a figure, table, or other reported result must be matched to the corresponding object in the paper. The two outputs are then merged by report_merger (GPT-5.1), which removes duplicate issues, combines the strengths, and harmonises the severity levels across the two calls. The merger belongs to a third family (OpenAI), so that neither of the two input families is favoured at the merge step [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 第一阶段是总_评论员综艺:两个平行的电话,一个是Claude Opus 4.7,一个是双子座 2.5 Pro,每个都以固定的JSON格式返回一个摘要,一个强项清单,以及三个按严重程度(主要,次要,非常次要)的问题清单. 这两种调用都使用同样的操作指令,要求涵盖五类(一般、逻辑一致性、证据和引证、列报和清晰度、可复制性)、关于指定选择和再使用数量各节之间的一致性传递、旨在抓住方向或类型的泛泛而论和矛盾的花言巧语和范围审计,以及虚幻证据审计,其中每提及一个数字、表格或其他报告结果都必须与文件中的相应目标相匹配。 然后通过报告_合并(GPT-5.1)合并这两个产出,消除了重复的问题,结合了优势,统一了两个呼号的严厉程度. 合并属于第3个家族(OpenAI),因此两个投入家族在合并阶段均不获青睐. [15].

blocks.en: In parallel with the structured ensemble, the unstructured_reviewer agent (GPT-5.4, high reasoning) reads the paper without a checklist. Its purpose is not coverage, which the structured pass already provides, but to bring extended reasoning to a workflow whose other parts run without it. This serves two ends. First, the free-form pass can raise concerns about the paper as a whole that fall outside the checklist. Second, it helps to establish the relative importance of the issues found by the structured calls, which are not necessarily reported in order of importance. This pass runs on the third frontier family (OpenAI), so that, taken together, the structured and unstructured parts of the general-issues module span Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI.
blocks.zh: 在结构化综艺的同时,无结构化的_评论员代理(GPT-5.4,高推理)读取论文时没有核对表. 它的目的不是覆盖(结构化通行证已经提供),而是将扩展推理带入工作流程,而其他部分则没有它运行. 这有两端 首先,自由式通行证可以引起对整个不属于清单范围的纸张的关切。 第二,它有助于确定结构性呼吁所发现问题的相对重要性,这些问题不一定按重要性来报告。 这个传球运行在第三个前沿家族(OpenAI)上,这样,将一般问题模块的结构化和无结构化的部分合在一起,跨越了Anthropic,Google,和OpenAI.

blocks.en: A.2 Mathematics module
blocks.zh: A.2 数学单元

blocks.en: The mathematics module audits the paper’s mathematics with a five-stage pipeline. The first stage extracts the mathematical statements in the paper, the second cross-checks them, the third verifies them mechanically (if applicable), and the fourth and fifth interpret and aggregate the results.
blocks.zh: 数学单元用五相管来审计论文的数学. 第一阶段取出论文中的数学报表,第二阶段交叉核对,第三阶段机械验证(如果适用),第四和第五阶段解释并汇总结果.

blocks.en: In stage 1, the maths_extractor agent (Gemini 2.5 Pro, high reasoning) extracts every mathematical statement that the paper presents as central (e.g., an equation, a derivation chain, a limit or series identity, a dimensional or normalisation constraint, a definition, or an inequality) into a structured record. The record contains the L a T e X of the statement, the verbatim source snippet, its location, the kind of statement, a flag marking whether units matter, and an executable plan for checking it. When a derivation chain contains an asserted equation, that equation is also extracted on its own, so that the derivation steps go to mechanical verification while the asserted starting equation receives a separate knowledge audit. The extractor must record every numbered equation it does not extract in an excluded_equations list, with a reason. If that list is empty while some equations remain uncovered, the extraction is repeated with reinforced instructions.
blocks.zh: 在第1阶段,数学_extractor agent(Gemini 2.5 Pro,高推理)将纸张作为中心(如方程,衍生链,限制或序列身份,维度或正态约束,定义,或不平等)呈现的每一个数学语句都取入有结构的记录. 记录中包含声明的L a T e X,逐字记录片断,位置,声明类型,标记单位是否重要,以及可执行的检查计划. 当一个衍生链包含一个声称的方程时,该方程也会自行取出,这样衍生出的步骤便会进行机械核查,而声称的起始方程则会接受单独的知识审计. 提取器必须记录它不提取的每一个被排除的方程式列表,并有原因. 如果该列表是空的,而一些等式仍然被揭开,则会用强化指令重复提取.

blocks.en: Stage 2 is a cross-family check of the extracted statements. For each of them, the maths_transcription_checker agent (Claude Opus 4.7) verifies two things. First, that the code prepared for the mechanical check in stage 3 faithfully reproduces the statement as it appears in the paper. Second, for any equation that the paper asserts rather than derives, such as a definition or a standard result quoted from the literature, that the equation matches the canonical form of the quantity it describes. This second check targets errors in prefactors, exponents, scaling factors, and subleading terms, which a mechanical check of the paper’s own derivation cannot detect, since the derivation can be internally consistent while starting from a wrong equation. We note that stages 1 and 2 run on different model families, which makes it less likely that an error of the extracting model, for instance a misread sign or exponent, is shared by the model that checks its work.
blocks.zh: 第二阶段是对提取的报表进行跨家庭检查。 对于每一个,数学_transcription_checker代理(Claude Opus 4.7)验证了两件事. 第一,为第3阶段的机械检查准备的代码忠实地照搬了文件中出现的声明。 第二,对于文件声称而不是从文献中引出的任何等式,如定义或标准结果,等式与其所描述的数量的犬形相匹配。 第二次检查针对的是前因子、导出物、缩放因子和次引出物中的错误,而机械检查纸张本身的衍生物是无法发现的,因为衍生物可以在内部一致,同时从错误的方程开始。 我们注意到,第1阶段和第2阶段在不同模式家庭上运行,这使得抽取模式的误差,例如误读标志或启事,不太可能被检查其工作的模式所分享。

blocks.en: In stage 3, the statements are verified mechanically. Symbolic equalities, limits, series identities, and solvability queries are checked with wolframscript . When a statement contains free symbols, it is also evaluated at ten random points of their parameter space. SymPy serves as a fallback if wolframscript crashes. In addition, pint performs the dimensional analysis of the statements flagged as unit-critical in stage 1. Each check returns one of six outcomes: confirmed , refuted , inconclusive , error , skipped , or unavailable .
blocks.zh: 在第三阶段,这些陈述是经过机械核实的。 用 wolframscript 检查符号等同性、限制、序列身份和溶解性查询。 当一个语句包含自由符号时,也会在其参数空间的十个随机点上进行评估. 齐姆 如果狼语崩溃, Py 充当倒计时。 此外,品脱对标出在舞台上对单位至关重要的声明进行维度分析 1. 联合国 每次检查返回六个结果之一:确认、反驳、无结论、出错、跳出或无法获取。

blocks.en: In stage 4, the maths_interpreter agent (Claude Opus 4.7) combines the outcome of the stage-2 check and the stage-3 mechanical verdict for each statement into a final judgement of pass , fail , or uncertain . Finally, in stage 5, the maths_aggregator agent (Gemini 2.5 Pro, high reasoning) compiles the per-statement judgements into the mathematics audit and writes a mathematics audit report that is attached to the final review.
blocks.zh: 在第四阶段,数学_解析剂(Claude Opus 4.7)将第2阶段检查的结果和每段语句的第3阶段机械判断合并为通过,失败,或不确定的最终判断. 最后,在第五阶段,数学_聚合剂(Gemini 2.5 Pro,高推理)将每个报表的判断汇编入数学审计,并写出数学审计报告,附于最后审查.

blocks.en: A.3 Numerics module
blocks.zh: A.3 数字模块

blocks.en: The numerics module verifies numerical statements with code. First, two extractor agents from different model families, numerics_extractor_a (Claude Opus 4.7) and numerics_extractor_b (GPT-5.5, high reasoning), read the PDF independently and each returns a list of numerical statements to be verified. Every statement is labelled with one of eleven kinds of check (agreement between abstract and body, a table-row total, a table-column total, percentages that should sum to one hundred, a percentage of a stated quantity, a ratio, a difference, an integer equality, a constant repeated across the paper, a rounded value, and a sum that should equal a stated total). To make sure that the statement refers to a number that actually appears in the paper, the extractor must also record where it found it. It does so by quoting a verbatim passage of at least eight consecutive words from the paper that contains the number, together with the number itself exactly as printed, without units or L a T e X markup.
blocks.zh: 数字模块用代码验证数字语句。 首先,两个来自不同模式家族的提取剂,数字_提取器_a (Claude Opus 4.7)和数字_extractor_b(GPT-5.5,高推理),独立地读取PDF,并各自返回需要验证的数字语句列表. 每一份报表都标有11种核对之一(抽象和正文之间一致,一表一行合计,一表一栏合计,百分数应相加为一百分数,百分数为申报数量,百分数为一分数,千分数为一分数,千分数为一整数等值,整数为一整数等值,一整数为一整数等值,一整数为一整数等值. 为了保证该语句提到实际上出现在纸张中的数字,提取器还必须记录它找到的地方. 它在这样做时,引用了纸上至少连续八个字的逐字记录,其中包含数字,以及数字本身完全如出一辙,没有单位或L a T e X 标记。

blocks.en: Second, a deterministic Python step compares the two lists and keeps only the statements on which both extractors agree, that is, those for which the quoted passage, the kind of check, and the printed number all match. Statements found by only one extractor are set aside in a separate list of unverified items. Each surviving statement is then re-read by the numerics_rereader agent (GPT-4.1). This agent is given only the quoted passage and the kind of check, not the number reported by the extractors, and is asked to state which number is printed in that passage. The statement is accepted for verification only if the number the re-reader reports matches the one both extractors gave. This removes a whole class of errors in which an extractor misreads or invents a number.
blocks.zh: 其次,一个决定性的Python步骤比较了两个列表,只保留了两个摘录者都同意的语句,即被引用的段落,检查的种类,以及被打印的号码都匹配的语句. 只有一名摘录人的发言被放在一份未经核实的单独清单中。 每个幸存的语句再由数字读取代理重读(GPT-4.1). 这个代理人只得到所引用的段落和检查类型,而不是提取器报告的号码,并且被要求说明该段落所打印的号码. 只有在重读报告与两个提取器给出的数字相匹配的情况下,该声明才被接受进行核查. 这可以去除一个提取器错误读取或发明数字的一整类错误.

blocks.en: Third, the accepted statements are verified by Python code, with no LLM involved. For each of the eleven kinds of check there is a fixed function that performs the corresponding arithmetic on the extracted numbers, for instance summing a table row and comparing the result with the printed total. When a check fails, a fixed rule assigns the severity according to the kind of check and the size of the discrepancy. Some problems cannot be found in this way, and a single LLM call is used for them. The numerics_reasoner agent (GPT-5.5) reads the full PDF once, with the results of the mechanical checks given to it so that it does not repeat them, and looks for two further kinds of problem: a quantity that is given different values in distant parts of the paper, and numerical errors that both extractors missed. Its findings are marked in the audit report as not mechanically verified. Each of them must be anchored to a verbatim quote from the paper, and a finding whose quote cannot be found in the paper is discarded. Finally, the numerics_reporter agent (GPT-4.1) compiles the mechanical and reasoner findings into a numerics audit report that is attached to the final review.
blocks.zh: 第三,接受的语句由Python代码验证,不涉及LLM. 对于11种检查中的每一种都有一个固定的函数,在取出的数字上进行相应的算术,例如对一行表格进行总结,并将结果与打印总数进行比较。 当检查失败时,固定规则会根据检查的类型和差异大小来分配严重程度. 某些问题无法以这种方式找到,并且对它们使用一个单一的LLM呼叫. 数字_推理剂(GPT-5.5)读取了PDF全文一次,并给出了机械检查的结果,使其不重复,并寻找另外两种问题:在纸张的远地部分给出不同值的数量,以及两个提取器都遗漏的数字错误. 其审计结果在审计报告中被标明为未经机械核实。 每一篇都必须用论文的逐字取出,而论文无法取出其引出的结论则被抛弃。 最后,数字-报告代理人(GPT-4.1)将机械和推理结果汇编成数字审计报告,附于最后审查后。

blocks.en: A.4 Citations module
blocks.zh: A.4 引用单元

blocks.en: The citations module checks the factual statements in the paper that rely on external references against the cited papers themselves, which it retrieves. It runs in two passes. In the first, the statement_extractor agent (GPT-5.1) reads the full text of the paper and returns the N N most important such statements. N N grows with the length of the paper, at one statement per ten thousand characters, up to a maximum of ten in order to bound the cost. Each statement is returned together with the reference identifier exactly as it appears in the paper (a BibTeX key, a numeric label, or an author-year string). Two further agents then connect the statements to the cited papers. First, the reference_extractor agent (GPT-4.1) copies the entries of the paper’s reference list verbatim. Then, the reference_resolver agent (GPT-5 mini) maps each in-text identifier to its entry in the reference list and from there to an arXiv identifier, resolving differences in numbering and in author-year forms (a smaller model suffices for this lookup step). The PDFs of the cited papers are then downloaded from the arXiv using the identifiers obtained in this way.
blocks.zh: 引文单元对照所取取的所引文件本身,核对文件中依赖外部引文的事实陈述。 它运行在两个通过。 在第一个语句中,语句_extractor agent(GPT-5.1)读取了论文的全文并返回了NN最重要的此类语句. N N随着纸张的长度而增长,每一万个字符有1个陈述,最多可有10个,以约束成本. 每个语句都与正文中出现的参考标识符(一个 BibTeX 密钥,一个数字标签,或者一个作者年字符串)一起返回. 随后还有两名代理人将发言与所引用的文件联系起来。 首先,参考出处(GPT-4.1)逐字复制了论文参考清单的条目。 然后,参考_resolver代理 (GPT-5 迷你) 将每个文本标识符都映射到引用列表的条目,并从此映射到arXiv标识符,解决了编号和作者年表的差异(一个更小的模型足以为这个查询步骤). 然后,从arXiv下载所引用文件的PDF,使用以这种方式获得的识别资料。

blocks.en: The statements are then verified. For each of them, the paper_verification_agent agent (Gemini 2.5 Pro, high reasoning) receives the statement together with the PDF of the cited paper and returns one of five verdicts: supported , weakly supported , partially supported , contradicted , or unrelated . The agent is instructed to use only the attached paper, which limits the influence of what the model may already know, or believe, about the cited work.
blocks.zh: 然后核实这些陈述。 对于其中的每一个,文件_验证_代理(Gemini 2.5 Pro,高推理)与被引用的论文的PDF一起收到声明并返回五个判决中的一个:支持,弱支持,部分支持,矛盾,或无关. 代理人被指示只使用所附的纸张,这限制了模型可能已经知道或相信的对被引用作品的影响.

blocks.en: In the second pass, the statement_extractor agent is run again, this time with the first-pass statements and their verdicts given to it so that it does not repeat them, and asked for up to three further statements that look suspicious. These are verified in the same way by the paper_verification_agent agent, and their verdicts are labelled as coming from the second pass, so that the two passes can be weighted separately later in the pipeline.
blocks.zh: 第二次传出时,声明_摘录代理再次运行,这次是先行传出声明和他们给它的判决,以免重复,并要求最多再有3个看起来可疑的声明. 这些文件由纸上_验证_代理代理以同样的方式验证,其判决被标注为出自第二次通行证,这样两张通行证可以在后期的管道中分别加权.

blocks.en: A.5 Coordination, assembly, and deployment
blocks.zh: A.5 协调、集结和部署

blocks.en: The four modules run concurrently, on four worker threads inside the Skepthical worker process. Once all four have finished, an assembly step builds the review in a fixed order as follows: it merges the two total_reviewer outputs through the report_merger agent, adds the paper title, appends the mathematics and numerics audit reports, folds in the free-form pass through the unstructured_report_merger agent, and finally inserts the per-statement verdicts of the citations module. The assembled review is then compiled to markdown and PDF.
blocks.zh: 四个单元同时运行,在Skepthical工人过程的四个工人线上. 四份全部完成后,一个组装步骤以固定顺序构建审查:它通过报告_合并代理合并了两个总_审查者输出,增加了纸张标题,附加了数学和数字审计报告,在自由形式中折叠通过无结构_报告_合并代理,最后插入引用模块的每份声明判断. 然后汇编汇总的审查报告,以标记下限和PDF。

blocks.en: Skepthical is deployed on Google Cloud Run and is accessible at skepthical-ai.org . Submitted papers are placed in a queue and processed by worker instances that run in parallel, so throughput grows with the number of workers. A typical 12-page astrophysics paper takes approximately 24 minutes.
blocks.zh: Skepthical在Google Cloud Run上部署, 所提交的证件排成队,由并行工作的工人进行处理,因此通过量随着工人人数的增加而增加。 一张12页的典型天体物理学论文大约需要24分钟.

First, a severity-balanced 3-copy schedule fixes how the twelve (error type, severity) combinations are distributed across the three injected copies of each paper, so that every combination is chosen exactly once. The validator accepts an edit only if the text to be replaced occurs exactly once in a source file that is part of the compiled document, the replacement actually changes the text, and no citation key is added, removed, or altered; the edited copy must also compile.

blocks.en: Several reviewer systems share an LLM provider family with one of the three judges of the detection-matching panel. Following [ 15 ] , this raises a self-preference concern: a judge might vote “detected” more readily on output from its own family than a judge from another family would on the same injection, which would inflate the detection rates of those reviewer systems. We test this for both corpora on the first-round panel votes themselves, comparing the judges within each injection, rather than by re-adjudicating with a substitute panel.

blocks.en: The split panels allow for a second test. On the 2 2 - 1 1 splits, the injections on which one judge disagreed with the other two, we ask how often the lone dissenter is the judge of the reviewer’s own family. If every judge dissents equally often, that share is one third. Self-preference would push it below one third on the 2 2 - 1 1 detected panels, where two judges found the error and the same-family judge would be expected to be among them, and above one third on the 1 1 - 2 2 not-detected panels, where only one judge found it and self-preference would make that one the same-family judge. Table 8 shows that the same-family judge is the lone dissenter in 25.2 % 25.2\,\% of the 107 107 astrophysics splits and 23.2 % 23.2\,\% of the 108 108 ML splits, and that on the not-detected panels, where self-preference would raise the share above one third, it is 16.9 % 16.9\,\% on astrophysics and 24.3 % 24.3\,\% on ML. Neither corpus shows the pattern that self-preference would produce.

blocks.en: Skepthical cannot be tested in this way, because its reviews are written by agents from all three families, so every judge is a same-family judge and there is none left to compare against. The question for Skepthical is nonetheless answered indirectly. If a judge favoured reviews written by models of its own family, this would appear as a positive Δ s \Delta_{s} for the systems built on that family: the four Anthropic-based systems for the Anthropic judge, and two systems each for the OpenAI and Google judges. It appears for none of the three judges, on either corpus, so there is no sign of the mechanism that could favour Skepthical .
blocks.zh: 滑稽不能以此来检验,因为其评论由三个家族的代理人所写出,所以每个法官都是同一家人的法官,没有比对的了. 然而,Skeepthical的问题却得到了间接的回答。 如果一名法官赞成由自己家庭的模型撰写的评议,那么,对于基于该家庭的系统来说,这似乎是积极的:Anthropic法官的四个基于Anthropic的系统,OpenAI和Google法官各两个系统。 3名法官中没有一个在任何一项诉讼案中出现过,所以没有迹象表明机制会有利于Skeepthical。

blocks.en: Two related concerns remain outside this test. First, the test can only detect a preference specific to one judge. A preference that is shared by all three, for instance for a certain style of review prose, would affect every reviewer system alike and cannot be detected by this test. Second, the human ground truth against which the panel can be checked is limited to the one-paper check of Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 有两个相关的关切仍未纳入这项检验。 首先,测试只能发现一个法官特有的偏好。 所有这三种人都赞同的一种偏好,例如一种某种形式的复议假说,将同样影响每个复议员制度,无法通过这一测试来发现。 第二,可以检查面板的人类基础真相仅限于附录F的一纸检查。

blocks.en: Finally, as an additional test, we ask how much the results depend on the size of the panel. In particular, we recompute every system’s detection rate with one judge family removed from the first-round panel, taking the majority of the remaining two votes and resolving 1 1 - 1 1 ties either strictly (not detected) or leniently (detected). On astrophysics, the same three systems stay on top whichever judge is removed, and with strict ties their order is also unchanged. In the worst case for Skepthical (Google removed, strict ties) its rate falls from 70.6 70.6 to 63.3 % 63.3\,\% , a change of 7.3 ​ pp 7.3\,\mathrm{pp} (CI [ 3.9 , 11.5 ] [3.9,11.5] ), and its lead over structured GPT-5.5 shrinks from 9.3 9.3 to 2.6 ​ pp 2.6\,\mathrm{pp} . On ML, structured GPT-5.5 stays in the first position whichever judge is removed, Skepthical and structured Claude Code, 3.3 ​ pp 3.3\,\mathrm{pp} apart at baseline, swap second and third place in two of the six variants, and Skepthical ’s largest change is 5.6 ​ pp 5.6\,\mathrm{pp} (CI [ 2.2 , 10.0 ] [2.2,10.0] ). With lenient ties, Skepthical ’s rate stays within 1.7 ​ pp 1.7\,\mathrm{pp} of its baseline in every variant on both corpora. Per-system rates under each variant are released with the benchmark.

blocks.en: Appendix F Human adjudication
blocks.zh: 附录F 人的裁判

blocks.en: The detection rates in this paper are computed from the verdicts of an LLM panel. As a validation of these verdicts, one of the authors annotated every detection decision for one astrophysics paper, without knowledge of the panel’s verdicts or of which system had written each review.
blocks.zh: 本文件中的检测率是根据LLM小组的裁决计算的。 作为这些判决的确认,一位作者在不知晓小组裁决或哪个系统撰写了每篇评论的情况下,对每份天体物理学论文的检测决定作了注释。

blocks.en: The paper, 2604.20975 , was drawn at random from the 15-paper corpus. Its three injected copies carry four injections each, and each copy was reviewed by the 12 systems, giving 36 reviews and 144 adjudications, each on whether a given review detected a given injection. Twelve of the 144 decisions concern three reviews for which no panel verdict was recorded, leaving 132 comparisons.
blocks.zh: 这份编号为2604.20975的论文是随意取自15个文件的。 其3个注射式副本各携带4个注射式副本,每份副本均由12个系统审查,给出了36个审查和144个裁定,每份裁定是针对某一次审查是否检测出某一次注射. 在144项裁决中,有12项涉及3项审查,没有记录小组判决,因此有132项比较。

blocks.en: On these 132, the annotator and the panel agree on 127 ( 96.2 % 96.2\,\% ; Cohen’s κ = 0.914 \kappa=0.914 ). The five disagreements are all in the same direction: the panel credited a detection that the annotator rejected. The panel’s detection rate on this paper is therefore slightly higher than the annotator’s, 34.8 34.8 against 31.1 % 31.1\,\% .
blocks.zh: 关于这132个问题,注释员和小组就127(96.2 % 96.2\ ;\;Cohen's $ = 0.914\kappa=0.914)达成一致。 这5个分歧都朝同一方向发展:小组将注释员拒绝的检测结果归结为小组。 因此,小组在本文上的检测率略高于注释者,34.8 34.8比31.1%的31.1%。

blocks.en: Three limitations apply. First, the check covers a single astrophysics paper. Annotating every review of a paper against every injection is labour-intensive, and extending it to further papers or to the ML corpus was beyond the resources of this work, so the agreement reported here is evidence about the panel on one paper rather than a corpus-wide validation. Second, with a single annotator, inter-annotator agreement cannot be measured, so a disagreement with the panel cannot be attributed to the panel rather than to the annotator. Third, the check covers detection only: the false-positive panel, which Appendix D shows to be the less reliable of the two, was not checked against a human.
blocks.zh: 有三个限制。 一,检查范围为单张天体物理论文. 对每一次注入一纸的每一份审查都加以说明是劳动密集型的,将审查扩大到进一步的文件或《劳动法典》,超出了这项工作的资源范围,因此,这里所报告的协议是一份文件上关于小组的证据,而不是一个全机构范围的鉴定。 第二,与单一的注释员,注释员之间的协议是无法衡量的,因此与评审小组的分歧不能归咎于评审小组而不是注释员. 第三,检查只包括检测:附录D显示两者中可靠性较低的假阳性面板没有针对人类进行检查。

Both use only the per-injection verdicts and severity labels already computed, resampling the 15 papers of a corpus ( n boot = 10,000 n_{\mathrm{boot}}=10{,}000 , against 2000 2000 for the intervals of § 3.1 ) or permuting severity labels within papers; no new LLM calls are made.

blocks.en: For each comparison made in § 3.1 , we resample the 15 papers with replacement, recompute the two rates on the same resampled papers, and take their difference. Table 9 gives the difference on the full corpus and the fraction of resamples in which its sign reverses, for the total rate and for each error type. We recall that the main text calls a difference significant when this fraction is below 0.05 0.05 . Four readings of the table are used there. blocks.en: Appendix H Structured-concise prompt baseline
blocks.zh: 附录H 结构简便的快速基准

blocks.en: The structured single-LLM configuration of § 2.1 uses Skepthical ’s full operating instructions as its prompt. Its gain over the free-form prompt can therefore come from two sources that the main comparison cannot separate: simply telling the model which four kinds of error to look for, and more detailed instructions on how to look for them. To separate the two, we wrote a 471-word ‘concise structured’ prompt that does only the first. This prompt asks the reviewer to examine citation support, numerical consistency, mathematical correctness, and logical or cross-section consistency, with a brief example of each. We ran it with the three single-LLM providers and inside Claude Code on all 60 copies of each corpus.
blocks.zh: § 2.1的结构化单-LLM配置使用 Skepthical 的全操作指令作为其快取. 因此,它对自由形式快取的收获可以来自两个来源,主要比较不能分开:简单地告诉需要寻找哪四种错误的模型,以及关于如何寻找这些错误的更详细指示. 为了将两者分开,我们写了一个471个字的 " 简洁的结构化 " 提示,这个提示只是第一个。 这个提示请审查者检查引用支持,数值一致性,数学正确性,以及逻辑或截面一致性,并分别有一个简短的例子. 我们和三个LLM供应商一起运行过 并且把Claude代码里的所有60份拷贝都放在每本书上

blocks.en: Table 11 shows the results next to those of the free-form and structured prompts. The concise prompt captures most of the detection gain of the structured one. Over the free-form prompt it raises total detection for every provider, by 8 8 – 16 ​ pp 16\,\mathrm{pp} on astrophysics and 12 12 – 38 ​ pp 38\,\mathrm{pp} on ML (all significant except Gemini on astrophysics, which falls just short), and inside Claude Code it accounts for 24.3 24.3 of the 32.2 ​ pp 32.2\,\mathrm{pp} between the free-form and structured prompts on astrophysics and 32.3 32.3 of 38.9 ​ pp 38.9\,\mathrm{pp} on ML. For the single LLMs, the structured prompt adds little over the concise one, and not uniformly: + 0.8 +0.8 , − 7.6 -7.6 , and + 16.4 ​ pp +16.4\,\mathrm{pp} for Claude, GPT-5.5, and Gemini on astrophysics, + 6.3 +6.3 , + 5.0 +5.0 , and + 2.2 ​ pp +2.2\,\mathrm{pp} on ML. blocks.en: Appendix I Module attribution
blocks.zh: 附录一 模块归属

blocks.en: A natural question about a multi-module reviewer such as Skepthical is which of its modules its detections come from. The rates of Table 2 credit Skepthical as a whole, so we attributed its astrophysics detections to modules by examining the reviews themselves. Each Skepthical review contains a general review and separate citation, mathematics, and numerics audit sections written by the specialist modules. For every injection of those three types, we recorded whether the corresponding specialist section identifies the injected error and whether the review identifies it anywhere, which is what the panel judges and Table 2 reports. This locates where the supporting evidence appears, although it does not say what would happen if a module were removed. The attribution was carried out by Claude in a single pass.
blocks.zh: 关于Skephthical等多模块审查器的自然问题,是其检测模块的哪个来源. 整个表2的速分率, 所以我们通过审查审查本身, 将天体物理学检测结果归结为模块。 每项 Skepthical Review 都包含一个一般性的审查和由专家单元撰写的单独的引用,数学,和数字的审计部分. 对于这三种类型的注射,我们记录了相应的专家部分是否识别出注入的错误,以及审查是否在任何地方识别出错误,这是小组法官和表2报告的内容。 其位置是证明证据出现的地方,尽管它没有说明如果一个模块被移除会发生什么事。 归属由克洛德在一次传球中完成.

blocks.en: The attribution results are as follows. The citation audit identifies 11 of the 21 citation errors the review finds. The main failure mode is that the citing claim was never selected for checking. The numerics audit identifies 27 of the 36 numerics errors the review finds ( 75 % 75\,\% ); its misses are statements never selected for a check, so claim selection is again its main failure. The mathematics audit identifies 7 of the 31 mathematics errors the review finds. Most mathematics detections thus come from the general-issues ensemble reading the whole paper. These results also argue against the explanation that Skepthical performs well merely because the benchmark’s error types mirror its module names: one specialist section supplies most of its corresponding detections, one about half, and one a minority.
blocks.zh: 归属结果如下. 引用审计查明了复核发现的21个引用错误中的11个. 主要的失败模式是,引证的索赔从未被选中进行核对. 数字审计识别了审查发现的36个数字错误中的27个(75% 75\, \ \ \ ) ; 它的缺失是从未选择过检查的报表, 因此索赔选择再次是其主要失败 。 数学审计确定了审查发现的31个数学错误中的7个. 因此,大多数数学检测来自阅读整篇论文的一般问题。 这些结果也反对这样的解释,即Skepthical的性能很好,仅仅因为基准的出错类型与它的模块名称相仿:一个专家科提供大部分相应的检测,大约一半,一个少数。

blocks.en: Appendix J Citation errors across the two corpora
blocks.zh: 附录J 两个公司之间的引用错误

blocks.en: On astrophysics, Skepthical detects 46.7 % 46.7\,\% of the injected citation errors and no other system more than 26.7 % 26.7\,\% . On ML, by contrast, two of the three structured single-LLM reviewers reach 57.8 % 57.8\,\% and Skepthical 53.3 % 53.3\,\% . In this appendix, we examine the origin of this discrepancy. We recall that the single LLMs receive one call with the paper attached and no tools, so they entirely rely on their pre-trained knowledge to detect the citation injections. Skepthical , on the other hand, retrieves and reads the cited papers.

This difference may arise because the ML corpus contains more citation errors that can be caught from familiarity with the field alone, because the models are more familiar with the ML literature, or through a combination of the two. To separate these contributions, we classified each of the 45 injected citation errors of each corpus into three groups. The first group contains errors that a reader familiar with the field could reject without opening the cited paper, for instance a well-known method attributed to the wrong paper. The second contains errors for which the cited paper is needed, for instance a dropped condition or a changed number. The third contains errors that could fall either way. The classification was made in a single pass by Claude. The two corpora differ markedly in this respect: errors of the first group are more than three times as common on ML as on astrophysics (14 against 4 of the 45).
blocks.zh: 之所以出现这种差异,可能是因为"ML"中包含更多的引用错误,这些错误可以从单从对字段的熟悉中捕捉到,因为模型更熟悉"ML"文献,或者通过两者的结合. 为了区分这些贡献,我们把每本书的45个输入引用错误分为三组。 第一组包含一些错误,熟悉这个字段的读者可以在不打开所引用的纸张的情况下拒绝这些错误,例如一种被归咎于错误纸张的众所周知的方法. 第二种情况包含需要引用的纸张的错误,例如一个被放弃的条件或一个已更改的号码。 第三个错误包含着任何一种可能发生的错误。 分类是由克洛德在一次通过中作出的. 这两只蝎子在这方面明显不同:第一组的错误在ML上比在天体物理学上常见的多出三倍多(45只中的14只对4只).

blocks.en: This difference in composition, however, explains only part of the single LLMs’ gain. Taken together, the three structured single LLMs detect 16.7 % 16.7\,\% of the citation errors on astrophysics and 47.4 % 47.4\,\% on ML, and had the ML errors been distributed across the groups in the astrophysics proportions they would still have detected 39.6 % 39.6\,\% . About a quarter of the gain therefore comes from the composition and the rest from higher detection within every group. The largest increase is in the first group, where knowing the field is enough. Skepthical ’s rate, by contrast, is within a few points of its astrophysics value once the composition is accounted for. In short, the single LLMs gained on ML both because more of the errors can be caught from familiarity with the field and because they are more familiar with it, whereas Skepthical , which retrieves the cited paper in every case, changed little.
blocks.zh: 然而,这种组成上的差别只是单项有限责任公司收益的一部分。 三个结构化的单一LLMS检测到天体物理学引用误差的16.7% 16.7% 和 ML 引用误差的47.4% 47.4% , 如果ML误差分布在天体物理学比例的组别中,它们仍能检测到39.6% 39.6% , 则 。 因此,大约四分之一的收益来自组成,其余收益来自每个群体内较高的检测。 增加最多的是第一组,在那里了解球场就足够了. 相比之下,在计算成份后,Skepthical的速率在天体物理学价值的几分之内。 简言之,单个LLMs在ML上得到了,因为更多的错误可以从对球场的熟悉中捕捉到,并且因为他们更熟悉球场,而Skepthical(在每一个案例中检索所引用的论文)则变化不大.

blocks.en: A reviewer reading an injected copy encounters four injected errors at once. A natural question to ask, which we examine in this appendix, is whether the detection of one error could depend on the severity of the other errors present in the same copy. A blatant error, in particular, may draw attention away from a subtle one. The most direct test would place each injected error in a copy of its own, which requires 12 injected copies per paper rather than three. For five papers alone this would amount to 60 additional reviewed copies, at a cost comparable to that of the entire astrophysics benchmark, so this experiment was not carried out.

blocks.en: Beyond per-injection agreement (Figure 5 ), we also test convergence at the paper level. blocks.en: M.1 Compute resources
blocks.zh: M.1 计算资源

blocks.en: The benchmark uses three classes of compute. (i) Hosted-API LLM calls to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google serve every Skepthical agent (Table 3 ), the six single-LLM reviewers, the two Claude Code configurations, and the detection-matching and false-positive adjudication panels; the local CPU footprint of these calls is negligible (orchestration drivers pinned to 10 cores via taskset ) since the work is dominated by external API latency. (ii) Skepthical itself runs as a Google Cloud Run worker (1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory per task), with a per-paper wall time of approximately 24 minutes (Appendix A ). (iii) The two self-hosted open-weights baselines, OpenReviewer-8B (bfloat16, ∼ \sim 16 GB) and the PaperAudit-Bench Qwen3-14B detector (bfloat16, ∼ \sim 28 GB weights plus key-value cache), run sequentially on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition GPU (96 GB VRAM). The host workstation is an AMD Ryzen Threadripper PRO 9995WX (96 cores, 192 threads, 502 GiB RAM) with two such GPUs attached; only one of the two was used for the open-weights baselines.

blocks.en: The mechanical-verification stack uses Wolfram Engine (proprietary, with a free developer licence from Wolfram Research), SymPy (BSD-3-Clause), and pint (BSD). The two open-weights baselines are used under their published licences: OpenReviewer-8B ( maxidl/Llama-OpenReviewer-8B ) under the Llama 3.1 Community License, as a Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct fine-tune; and the PaperAudit-Bench Qwen3-14B detector ( mayiwen/PaperAudit_Qwen3_14B_sft_rl ) under Apache-2.0. The hosted LLMs from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google (identifiers in Table 3 and § 2.1 ) are accessed under each provider’s terms of service. The two 15-paper corpora consist of arXiv preprints used for research purposes only, with each paper credited individually in Appendix B ; the papers themselves are not redistributed, and the release identifies them by their arXiv identifiers.
